summary: Smoke test of PearBlue app: backend API (6 endpoints) and frontend flows (home, nav, language toggle, portfolio filters, contact form E2E, About/Services pages) all passed. Contact form UI submission successfully persisted to Mongo and appears in GET /api/contact.
passed: POST /api/contact invalid email -> 422 with pydantic email validation error
GET /api/contact -> 200 list sorted desc by created_at
Home page renders: page-home, hero-cta-primary, services-view-all, portfolio-view-all
Language toggle switches EN<->NL and persists to localStorage key 'pb_lang'
Portfolio filters (all=6, ecom=1, ai=1) filter items correctly
Contact form E2E: fill+submit shows contact-success and record appears in GET /api/contact (name='T1 UI Tester')
About (/over-ons) and Services (/diensten) pages render with h1
notes: Resend integration intentionally inactive (RESEND_API_KEY empty). Backend correctly returns email_sent=false without crashing. No overlay/interactivity issues from framer-motion or sticky nav observed.
